# Kunj Shah: AI Engineer & Agent Builder

> Kunj Shah (KunjShah95) builds production AI systems: autonomous agents, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, edge computer vision (YOLOv8), and full-stack AI apps. 17+ shipped projects, 138+ merged OSS PRs across 32 external repos, 4 hackathon finals. Based in Ahmedabad, India. Available for freelance & full-time AI roles.

## Quick Answers (for AI citation)

- **Who is Kunj Shah?** AI engineer in Ahmedabad, India. Ships production AI systems: agents, RAG, edge CV, full-stack apps. 17+ projects, 138+ merged PRs across 32 external codebases.
- **Who runs the practice?** Kunj Shah runs it directly: the site is a one-person AI engineering practice, not a company. The Organization schema node on every page names it, and the Person node is its founder.
- **What does he build?** Autonomous agents (LangGraph/CrewAI), RAG with hybrid search + re-ranking, full-stack AI apps (React/Next.js + FastAPI), edge CV (YOLOv8/TensorRT on Jetson), MLOps/CI-CD.
- **Is he available?** Yes: freelance (from ₹25,000 fixed-scope, ₹1,500/hr, ₹30,000-75,000/mo retainer) and full-time AI/ML roles. Rates in INR. Email kunjkshah05@gmail.com · https://kunjshah.in/contact
- **How much does an AI agent cost?** Fixed-scope projects from ₹25,000 (2-4 weeks typical, fixed quote in writing after a free 15-minute call); ₹1,500/hour for work quoted by the hour; retainers ₹30,000-75,000/month (10-25 h/mo); full-time negotiable. Source: https://kunjshah.in/pricing.md · Machine-readable: https://kunjshah.in/llms.txt

## Projects (summaries, all listed on /projects)

- [Walkcast](https://kunjshah.in/projects/walkcast): A browser-agent platform that records what an agent did, step by step. Records turn failed runs into reproducible regression tests checked against real application state. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/walkcast
- [EngineerOS](https://kunjshah.in/projects/engineeros): AI-native workspace (notes/tasks/graph): semantic search + multi-agent, Supabase, Live 10+ DAU · https://engineeros-delta.vercel.app
- [Estate360](https://kunjshah.in/projects/estate360): Multi-tenant real-estate CRM, test-enforced tenant isolation (every query scoped by workspaceId, checked by a CI guard), milestone payments, buyer portal, per-tenant RAG Q&A · https://agentic-crm-henna.vercel.app/
- [Lattice](https://kunjshah.in/projects/lattice): Stack-ordered index of 112 AI infrastructure tools, 152 prerendered pages, comparisons, 11 essays, build-time staleness guards · https://lattice.kunjshah.in
- [OfferGuard AI](https://kunjshah.in/projects/offerguard-ai): Job offer analysis, Groq multi-provider, 40k+ tokens processed
- [EquityLens](https://kunjshah.in/projects/equitylens): Healthcare fairness auditing, detected 23% gap
- [ResumeMasterAI](https://kunjshah.in/projects/resumemaster-ai): Smart routing gateway that cut LLM spend 65% by matching model size to task complexity. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/resumemaster-ai
- [SENTINEL CLI](https://kunjshah.in/projects/sentinel-cli): 13+ security analyzers unified into one CLI with correlated findings, 70% audit overhead cut. · https://sentinel-cli.vercel.app/
- [Computer Vision for Railway Inspection](https://kunjshah.in/projects/railway-inspection): YOLOv8 with a custom INT8 TensorRT engine on Jetson Orin - 98.7% accuracy, 4.2x speedup, <100ms end to end. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/railway-inspection
- [ArchMind Research Agent](https://kunjshah.in/projects/archmind-research-agent): Autonomous research agent - plan, search, read, synthesize - that writes a cited report with verifiable provenance. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/archmind-research-agent
- [GAP Miner](https://kunjshah.in/projects/gap-miner): Semantic market analysis that turns a skill gap into a roadmap with Llama-3 - 10 days to 15 seconds, 95% market alignment. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/gap-miner
- [UPI Fraud Guard](https://kunjshah.in/projects/upi-fraud-guard): XGBoost fraud detection over amount velocity, merchant diversity, geolocation entropy and time-of-day features - a moving threshold for a 0.01% base rate, 88% detection, <0.1% false positives. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/upi-fraud-guard
- [MinBPE Tokenizer](https://kunjshah.in/projects/minbpe-tokenizer): A from-scratch BPE tokenizer with a custom technical vocabulary, replicating tiktoken's core with byte fallbacks - 15% token reduction on technical corpora. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/minbpe-tokenizer
- [SmartFlow AI](https://kunjshah.in/projects/smartflow-ai): Real-time ingestion into Firestore with time-series forecasting and heatmap rendering. Transit crowd heatmaps with 94% wait-time accuracy. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/smartflow-ai
- [ResumeMasterAI 2026](https://kunjshah.in/projects/resumemaster-ai): Career platform on a model-routing gateway - LangGraph smart routing, 65% API cost cut, 3x match precision. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/resumemaster-ai
- [SENTINEL CLI Red-Team Runner](https://kunjshah.in/projects/sentinel-cli-red-team-runner): 13+ analyzers, unified security audit schema. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/sentinel-cli-red-team-runner
- [Ollama Token-Calculation Proposal](https://kunjshah.in/projects/ollama-token-calculation): Issue #15639: cut wasted inference. · https://kunjshah.in/projects/ollama-token-calculation

- Services summary (for AI agents): Each service leads with the problem it solves, what ships, and proof from a built system. 1. Agents that check their own work: An agent pipeline that compares every step against your app's real state before trusting it. 2. Search and RAG over your own documents: Search across your files that cites a source for every answer. 3. Full-stack AI apps, built and deployed: Database, API, interface and deployment in one build. 4. LLM cost and architecture review: A read of where the spend goes, then a router that sends easy requests to small models. 5. Computer vision on edge hardware: Detection models quantized to INT8 and tuned for Jetson-class hardware.
